breed.appearance: A medium, muscular short-coated dog that is mostly white with large glossy black patches over both eyes and ears, split by a broad white blaze running up the forehead, and a black spot on the side of the muzzle and upper lip. breed.fun_fact: Boxers are famous for their goofy, bouncy 'kidney bean' wiggle when they're happy, and they stay playful puppies at heart for years!
